payload.title: frick-store: store ports + SQLite backend
payload.description: Define the durable + cache store port traits mirroring the current storage seam, and implement the SQLite backend (rusqlite). Cover all runtime stores: objects, streams, sessions, presence, signals, projections, jobs, blob metadata, grants. Local DBs are disposable per docs/status.md — no migration from node:sqlite files required, but keep the schema layout rational for the Postgres port.
